# City of Martin, Tennessee

> > Official municipal government website for the City of Martin, Tennessee, providing access to city services, staff directories, and local government operations.

This site serves as the primary digital gateway for residents and visitors to access City of Martin government services, including City Hall operations, Human Resources, utility billing, property taxes, and contact information for city departments. The city is located in Weakley County, Tennessee and operates under various federal compliance guidelines including Title VI, Title IX, ADA, and Section 504.

## Core Government Services

- [City of Martin, Tennessee Official Home Page](https://mail.cityofmartin.net/): Homepage for City of Martin, TN municipal services and community info
- [City Hall](https://mail.cityofmartin.net/cityhall.htm): Martin City Hall services, meeting agendas, and government operations
- [Human Resource Department](https://mail.cityofmartin.net/hr.htm): City of Martin HR department for employment and employee benefits

## Staff & Contact Information

- [City Staff Email Directory](https://mail.cityofmartin.net/staffdirectory.htm): Contact directory for City of Martin staff across departments and agencies

## City Services & Facilities

- [Martin Cemeteries](https://mail.cityofmartin.net/cemetery.htm): Martin city cemetery services, locations, and burial regulations

## Optional

- [Reelfoot Lake](https://mail.cityofmartin.net/reelfoot.htm): Reelfoot Lake State Park and wildlife refuge recreation information
